findings.result: AIGFS became operational on 2025-12-17 at 12 UTC; evaluation data began 2025-12-09; files are GRIB2 on NOMADS only; sfc files include TMP at 2 m above ground; forecast hours are 000..384 every 6 hours.
Inventory lists aigfs.tCCz.pres.fFFF.grib2 and aigfs.tCCz.sfc.fFFF.grib2, with GRIB2 via NOMADS HTTPS and no NWS FTP server.
Inventory for sfc f000 includes TMP at 2 m above ground.
Directory listing returned only recent rotating operational dates aigfs.20260529 through aigfs.20260607 when tested; no requested-range history was exposed.
HTTP 403 when tested; requested-range AIGFS file not obtainable from NOMADS.
Obtained current index; line 3 is TMP:2 m above ground:24 hour fcst, proving current AIGFS 2 m temperature is scriptable from NOMADS.
HTTP 403 when tested; evaluation-period AIGFS files were not obtainable from this public path.
Registry says AIGFS/AIGEFS are operational replacements for EAGLE SOLO/Ensemble; EAGLE SOLO ran 2024-04-24 06Z through 2025-12-18 18Z; AIGFSdev forecasts continue separately.
